post.summary: Register a user and obtain a token

201.description: User created. Returns the public user data and an access token.

post.summary: Log in and obtain a token
Log out by revoking the current token
Add a game to a training session
post.description: Only the creator of the session can add games. The PGN must be at most 50000 characters and contain a valid mainline.

delete.summary: Delete a game from a training session
delete.description: Only the creator of the session can delete its games.

get.description: Only the creator of the session can view it. The response includes the games of the session.

200.description: Training session returned, including its games.

delete.description: Only the creator of the session can delete it. A session that is linked to a workspace or has responses cannot be deleted: unlink it first.

patch.description: Only the creator of the session can update it.

get.summary: List the responses to a linked training session
get.description: Available to any member of the workspace. Members who can respond (students) only see the other responses after submitting their own: until then the list is empty. The responses of former members of the workspace are kept and still listed.

post.summary: Respond to a linked training session
post.description: Only members with the training-sessions.respond permission (currently students) can respond. Each student can send a single response per session and workspace. The author is the authenticated user. The session must be linked to the workspace.

delete.description: Only the owner can delete the workspace.

patch.description: Only the owner can update the workspace.

get.summary: List the members of a workspace
get.description: Available to any member of the workspace. The owner is included in the list.

post.summary: Add a member to a workspace
post.description: Only the owner can add members. The user must already be registered. Returns 422 if the data is invalid, the email does not belong to a registered user or the user already belongs to the workspace.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a workspace
delete.description: The owner can remove any member. Any member can remove themselves (leave the workspace). The owner cannot be removed.

get.summary: List the training sessions linked to a workspace
get.description: Available to any member of the workspace. Returns an empty list if no sessions are linked.

post.summary: Link an existing training session to a workspace
post.description: Only the owner or a coach of the workspace can link a session, and only one they created. Linking the same session again does not create duplicates.

204.description: Session linked, or the link already existed.

get.summary: Get a training session linked to a workspace
get.description: Available to any member of the workspace, whoever created the session. The session must be linked to the workspace.

200.description: Linked training session returned, including its games.

delete.summary: Unlink a training session from a workspace
delete.description: The owner can unlink any session; a coach can unlink only the sessions they created. Only the link is removed: the session itself and its links to other workspaces are kept.

get.summary: Download a linked training session as a PDF
get.description: Available to any member of the workspace. The session must be linked to the workspace.

200.description: PDF of the selected training session.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment with the file name, for example: attachment; filename=training-session-3.pdf

get.summary: Check that the application is running

training_session_id.description: ID of an existing session created by the authenticated user

pgn.example: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 *

pgn.description: Game in PGN format. It must contain a valid mainline.
pgn.example: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 *

role.description: Role of the authenticated user in this workspace

user_id.description: ID of the student who wrote the response

Forbidden.description: You do not have permission to perform this action.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state (for example, it already exists).
